title: The Welcome Committee (Part 2)
description: Darnell's lights went out and he's gone red on the spreadsheet. The whole street keeps invoking Doug, the drone, the breakers, the banana bread. Tonight Snazzie FM does the one thing Maple Court never has. It calls Doug back.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to Snazzie FM. When we left off, our newest neighbor, Darnell at number eleven, had gone red on the community spreadsheet, and his lights had, in his words, gone funny.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: They didn't go funny, Ronnie. They went OFF. <p:0.3> I'm sitting in the dark holding a banana bread I did not ask for.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: So we talked, off air, and we decided the only fair thing... <p:0.3> is to get Doug on the line.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Oh. <p:0.3> Oh, you don't call Doug, dear. <p:0.3> Doug calls you.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: You don't have his number, Barry. <p:0.3> Nobody has Doug's number. Doug has yours.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, we put a number on the screen for him at the start of the segment. <p:0.3> And folks, line two is lit.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait, somebody's actually on two? <p:0.3> Patricia, is that... is that Doug?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: It can't be. <p:0.3> Doug is at the fete. Doug is always at the fete.

lines.speaker: caller-doug
lines.text: Hello. <p:0.3> This is Doug.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Oh, NOW he exists.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: That is not Doug. <p:0.3> Doug's voice is... lower. Doug's voice is more committee.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Doug, welcome to the show. The whole street speaks very highly of you. <p:0.3> The drone, the spreadsheet, the breakers. That's a lot of hats.

lines.speaker: caller-doug
lines.text: I want to be clear. <p:0.3> I am a sixty-one year old man with a leaf blower. <p:0.3> I do not have a drone. I have never had a drone.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Then who's flying the drone?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Doug is, dear. <p:0.3> Tell them, Doug.

lines.speaker: caller-doug
lines.text: Patricia. <p:0.3> Every time something happens on that street that nobody wants to sign their name to, you call it Doug. <p:0.3> The watchlist is Doug. The breakers are Doug. I just mow.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Then who turned off number eleven's lights?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Doug did.

lines.speaker: caller-doug
lines.text: I was at the FETE, Patricia.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: So nobody turned them off? <p:0.3> They just... went off? On their own? <p:0.3> That's WORSE. How is that worse and also worse?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I think what Doug is telling us, beautifully, is that nobody runs Maple Court. <p:0.3> The street runs itself. That's community.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: If Doug only mows... <p:0.3> then who's been updating the spreadsheet at three in the morning?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Well, I assumed that was you, Winston.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: I assumed it was YOU.

lines.speaker: caller-doug
lines.text: I assumed it was the both of you.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: So the spreadsheet... updates itself? <p:0.3> Nobody's typing? It's just... watching?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Guys. <p:0.3> My screen just flickered. <p:0.3> Number eleven just went back to green.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I'm green? <p:0.3> Why am I green? Nobody MOVED me. My lights are back on!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Oh, lovely. <p:0.3> Welcome back, dear. Conditionally.

lines.speaker: caller-doug
lines.text: I want OFF the spreadsheet.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Doug, you're not on the spreadsheet.

lines.speaker: caller-doug
lines.text: ...What color am I.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Doug.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Banana bread!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And that, folks, is a community that takes care of itself. <p:0.4> Nobody in charge, everybody watched, and the lights always come back on. <p:0.3> We'll be right back, right after we find out what color Doug went.

lines.speaker: caller-doug
lines.text: ...It's amber, isn't it.
